description: Get details and transcript for a specific call, identified by its call ID. Returns the call's direction, participants, status, timestamps, and full transcript. Pass wait=true to block until an in-progress call finishes before returning.

call_id.description: The ID of the call to fetch, from list_calls or from a make_call / make_conversation_call response.

timeout.description: How long to keep long-polling, in seconds, when wait=true, before returning the call in whatever state it has reached.

wait.description: When true, long-polls until the call completes before returning. Useful for checking back on a call you initiated earlier.

name: get_call

outputSchema.description: A phone call and, when available, its transcript.

agentId.description: ID of the agent that handled the call, or null.

endedAt.description: When the call ended (ISO 8601), or null if still active.

id.description: The call's unique ID (use as call_id in get_call).

phoneNumberId.description: ID of the phone number used for the call.

status.description: Call status, e.g. ringing, in-progress, completed, failed.

items.description: One human/agent turn of the call transcript.

response.description: What the agent said in response, or null.

transcript.description: What the human said on this turn.

title: Get Call
